save_custom_profile.name: Save custom profile
save_custom_profile.description: Change a custom charging profile saved in the Anker cloud (the app's custom modes): its name, port powers, protocols and automatic deactivation. Unset fields keep their value. Doesn't apply it to the charger; select it in Charging mode for that.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name of the saved custom profile to change.

from_charger.name: Start from the charger's settings
from_charger.description: Start from the charger's current custom settings (the custom power limit, protocol and automatic deactivation entities) instead of the profile's own; the fields below change them further.

set_custom_settings.name: Set custom settings
set_custom_settings.description: Change several of the charger's custom charging mode settings at once: port power limits, protocols and automatic deactivation. Unset fields keep their value. Sent in one command, so the charger cuts and renegotiates all ports only once (any custom-mode change does that, also in the app). Switches the charger to the custom mode; nothing is sent if nothing changes.

set_days.name: Set days
set_days.description: Set the weekdays of a port's scheduled start or end, or of the clock display. Target the matching days entity (e.g. USB-C 1 Schedule end days).

days.name: Days
days.description: The days to set. None selected: no day.

set_protocols.name: Set protocols
set_protocols.description: Set the fast-charging protocols a USB-C port allows in the custom charging mode. Target the port's Custom protocols entity. Which protocols are possible depends on the port's custom power (attribute 'allowed'). Re-applies the custom mode, which briefly disconnects the charging devices.

protocols.name: Protocols
protocols.description: The protocols to allow. None selected: none.
